ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:9 (high-to-low intensity); the visible surface is predominantly dark pixels with localized high-intensity white clusters at the distal tips and as scattered mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity region at the distal-most extremity of the left lobe. Discrete, non-contiguous white-pixel focal spots are distributed across the superior medial regions of both lobes and the distal-superior quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a vertex angle of approximately 78 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth equivalent to roughly 12% of the visible fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency irregular serration along the trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys varies between 3 and 15 pixels relative to the local edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature of the trailing edges originating from the median notch and extending toward the distal tips, which exhibit an upward-tapering sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular high-contrast white clusters (3-8 pixel diameter) concentrated on the superior-lateral portion of the right lobe and within the white region of the left tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Substantial irregular white pigmentation/scarring covering the distal lateral tip of the left lobe; a distinct dark, irregular protrusion or parasitic attachment is visible at the extreme lateral point of the right lobe tip.
